action.objective: Verify b1c3 as the primary development move, confirming it holds up against Black's replies without tactical refutation.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search over all 20 legal moves returned b1c3 as an exact-bound top candidate (score 52), tied with b1a3, g1f3, g1h3 and a2a3 but the only one with bound=exact. Knight to c3 develops a minor, controls d5/e4, and keeps options for e4/d4 and castling. Other minors (c1, f1) lack good squares yet. Now running single-candidate verification on the reserved suggestion b1c3 within its 2000-node allowance.
